dialogue: Woman: The boy is sitting under the tree and reading a book.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The boy is climbing a big tree to play.
(B) The boy is sitting at his desk doing homework.
(C) The boy is sitting under a tree and reading.
explanation: 句子說「男孩坐在樹下看書」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。(A) 爬樹、(B) 在書桌前，均與句意不符。
optionsZh: 男孩坐在書桌前寫作業。

dialogue: Man: The woman is carrying two heavy bags and walking toward the bus stop.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) A woman is sitting on a bus and resting.
(B) A woman is walking to the supermarket with empty hands.
(C) A woman is carrying two heavy bags toward the bus stop.
explanation: 句子說「女士提著兩個重袋走向公車站」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。(B) 空手、(A) 坐在車上，均不符。
optionsZh: 女士提著兩個重袋走向公車站。

dialogue: Woman: It has been raining since morning and the streets are flooded.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The sky is sunny and the roads are dry.
(B) It rained a little but stopped quickly.
(C) It has been raining all morning and the streets are flooded.
explanation: 句子說「從早上就下著雨，街道積水」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。(A) 晴天、(B) 雨已停，均不符。
optionsZh: 下了點小雨，很快就停了。
從早上就一直下雨，街道積水。

dialogue: Man: The girl is watering the flowers in the garden while listening to music.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) A girl is watering flowers in the garden while listening to music.
(B) A girl is picking flowers in the garden by herself.
(C) A girl is playing guitar inside the house.
explanation: 句子說「女孩邊聽音樂邊在花園澆花」，(A) 完全符合，故選 A。(C) 在室內彈吉他、(B) 摘花，均不符。
optionsZh: 女孩邊聽音樂邊在花園澆花。

dialogue: Woman: Three dogs are sleeping next to each other under the big tree.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) Two dogs are playing beside the tree.
(B) One dog is climbing up the big tree.
(C) Three dogs are sleeping together under the big tree.
explanation: 句子說「三隻狗在大樹下並排睡覺」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。(A) 兩隻、在玩，(B) 一隻、爬樹，均不符。
optionsZh: 三隻狗在大樹下一起睡覺。

dialogue: Man: The family is having a picnic in the park and the children are flying kites.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) A family is celebrating a birthday at a restaurant.
(B) Children are playing soccer in the park.
(C) A family is having a picnic and the children are flying kites.
explanation: 句子說「全家在公園野餐，孩子們放風箏」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。(A) 在餐廳、(B) 踢足球，均不符。
optionsZh: 全家在公園野餐，孩子們放風箏。

dialogue: Woman: The man is cooking in the kitchen and talking on the phone at the same time.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) A man is ordering food at a restaurant on the phone.
(B) A man is washing dishes after dinner.
(C) A man is cooking in the kitchen while talking on the phone.
explanation: 句子說「男士在廚房邊煮飯邊講電話」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。(A) 在餐廳點餐、(B) 洗碗，均不符。
optionsZh: 男士在餐廳用電話點餐。
男士在廚房邊煮飯邊講電話。

dialogue: Man: The boy is riding his bike to school and waving to his friends on the way.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) A boy is walking to school with a big backpack.
(B) A boy is taking the bus to school.
(C) A boy is riding his bike to school and waving to his friends.
explanation: 句子說「男孩騎腳踏車上學並向朋友揮手」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。(A) 走路、(B) 搭公車，均不符。
optionsZh: 男孩走路上學並背著大書包。
男孩騎腳踏車上學並向朋友揮手。

dialogue: Man: Do you know where the nearest ATM is?
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) Yes, there's one right around the corner.
(B) I don't have a credit card.
(C) My bank is closed on weekends.
explanation: 問「最近的 ATM 在哪裡？」，(A) 「就在轉角那裡」直接回答位置，最恰當，故選 A。

dialogue: Woman: Would you like some more coffee?
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) I usually wake up at seven.
(C) Coffee is really expensive these days.
explanation: 問「還要再來點咖啡嗎？」，(B) 「不了謝謝，我喝夠了」是直接正確的回應，故選 B。

dialogue: Man: I just got promoted at work!
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) When did you start working there?
explanation: 男士說升職了，(C) 「恭喜！你真的值得」是最合適的回應，故選 C。(B) 「遺憾」不合情境。
optionsZh: 你什麼時候開始在那裡工作的？

dialogue: Woman: Have you seen my glasses? I can't find them anywhere.
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) I like your glasses very much.
(B) Glasses are very expensive to fix.
(C) I think you left them on the dining table.
explanation: 問「有沒有看到我的眼鏡？」，(C) 「我覺得你放在餐桌上了」直接給出線索，最恰當，故選 C。
optionsZh: 我覺得你放在餐桌上了。

dialogue: Man: Is it okay if I sit here?
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) Sure, no one's using that seat.
(B) Yes, but the chair is broken.
explanation: 問「我可以坐這裡嗎？」，(A) 「當然，那個位子沒人坐」是正確允許的回應，故選 A。(B) 若椅子壞了不應說「可以」。

dialogue: Woman: Could you turn down the music a little? I'm trying to study.
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) I don't know how to play music.
explanation: 請求「可以把音樂調小聲一點嗎？」，(B) 「當然，不好意思」是禮貌正確的回應，故選 B。
optionsZh: 我不知道怎麼播放音樂。

dialogue: Man: Can you recommend a good restaurant near here?
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) That restaurant was closed when I arrived.
(B) I had lunch at home today.
(C) There's a great Italian place just two blocks away.
explanation: 問「附近有好餐廳推薦嗎？」，(C) 「兩個街區外有家很棒的義大利餐廳」直接回答，故選 C。
optionsZh: 我到的時候那家餐廳已關門了。
兩個街區外有家很棒的義大利餐廳。

dialogue: Woman: I'm thinking of learning to play the guitar. Any tips?
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) Start with simple songs and practice every day.
(B) I prefer listening to classical music.
(C) Guitars are really expensive to buy.
explanation: 問學吉他有什麼訣竅，(A) 「從簡單的歌開始，每天練習」是實用的建議，故選 A。
optionsZh: 從簡單的歌開始，每天練習。

dialogue: Man: Aren't you going to eat anything? It's already noon.
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) Yes, I had a big breakfast this morning.
(B) Lunch is usually my favorite meal.
(C) I'm not really hungry right now.
explanation: 問「你不打算吃東西嗎？已經中午了。」，(C) 「我現在不太餓」直接回答原因，故選 C。
optionsZh: 有啊，我今早吃了豐盛早餐。
午餐通常是我最喜歡的一餐。

dialogue: Woman: I can't believe it's already the last day of school!
question: Which is the best response?
options: (C) I forgot to bring my textbook.
explanation: 感嘆「竟然已經是最後一天了！」，(A) 「我知道！時間過得真快」是最自然的附和，故選 A。

dialogue: Man: My flight got delayed by two hours. What should I do?
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) Flying is my favorite way to travel.
(B) You could grab something to eat at the airport.
(C) The airport is really far from the city center.
explanation: 說「班機延誤兩小時，我該怎麼辦？」，(B) 「可以去機場裡吃點東西」是實用建議，故選 B。
optionsZh: 搭飛機是我最喜歡的旅行方式。
你可以去機場裡吃點東西。
機場離市中心真的很遠。

dialogue: Woman: Do you know where I can find Dr. Holland? I need to talk to him.
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) I'm not sure. Have you tried calling him?
(B) Dr. Holland is a very kind person.
(C) Yes, you can go ask him yourself.
explanation: 問「Holland 博士在哪裡？」，(A) 「不確定，你有試著打電話給他嗎？」承認不清楚並給出建議，最合適，故選 A。
optionsZh: 我不確定，你有試著打電話給他嗎？
Holland 博士是個很親切的人。

dialogue:
Man: Hey, are you still coming to the park tomorrow?
Woman: I just checked the forecast. It's going to be really cold. Maybe we should change our plans.
Man: What about going to an indoor game center instead?
Woman: That sounds fun! Let's do that.
question: What do they decide to do?
options: (A) Have a picnic in the park.
(C) Go to an indoor game center.
explanation: 因為天氣冷，取消去公園的計畫，最後決定去室內遊戲中心，故選 C。

dialogue:
Woman: Welcome. Are you ready to order?
Man: Yes. I'd like the chicken salad and a glass of orange juice, please.
Woman: Sorry, we're out of orange juice today. Would you like lemonade instead?
Man: Sure, that works.
question: What drink does the man order in the end?
explanation: 柳橙汁賣完，男士接受改點檸檬水，故選 C。

dialogue: Woman: The school library has a few rules. Please keep your voice down at all times. All books must be returned within two weeks. Food and drinks are not allowed inside. If you have questions, please ask the librarian.
question: Which rule about the library is correct?
options: (A) Drinks are allowed but food is not.
(B) Visitors must keep quiet at all times.
(C) Books must be returned within one week.
explanation: 規定說「隨時保持安靜」，(B) 正確。書籍是兩週內歸還（非一週）；食物和飲料都不允許（非只禁食物），故選 B。
optionsZh: 可以喝水但不能吃食物。
訪客必須隨時保持安靜。
書籍必須在一週內歸還。

dialogue:
Boy: Mom, I can't find my PE uniform. I have class tomorrow.
Mom: Did you check your gym bag?
Boy: I looked. It's not there.
Mom: Oh, I think I left it in the dryer. Let me check.
Boy: Thank goodness. That was close.
question: Where is the PE uniform most likely?
explanation: 媽媽說她覺得把衣服放在烘乾機裡忘了拿，故選 B。

dialogue:
Woman: Any plans for the weekend?
Man: I was going to go hiking, but my knee has been bothering me. I think I'll just stay home and watch movies.
Woman: I'm sorry to hear that. Hope you feel better soon.
Man: Thanks. What about you?
Woman: I'm going to my cousin's wedding on Saturday.
question: What will the man do this weekend?
explanation: 男士因膝蓋不舒服，放棄登山計畫，決定待在家看電影，故選 A。去婚禮是女士的計畫。

dialogue: Man: Our community center is looking for volunteers this Saturday from nine to twelve. Volunteers will help sort donated clothes and prepare food packages for families in need. No experience is needed. If interested, please sign up at the front desk by Friday.
question: Which statement about the volunteer event is correct?
options: (A) The event is held on Sunday.
(B) No experience is needed to join.
explanation: 廣播說「不需要任何經驗」，(B) 正確。活動在星期六（非星期日），故選 B。
optionsZh: 報名者必須有相關工作經驗。

dialogue:
Woman: How did your math test go?
Man: Better than I expected! I got an 88.
Woman: That's great! You were so stressed about it.
Man: I know. I stayed up until midnight studying, and it paid off.
Woman: Well done. Let's celebrate with ice cream!
question: Which statement about the man is correct?
options: (A) He thought the test was easy.
(C) He stayed up late studying and got a good grade.
explanation: 男士熬夜讀書到午夜，考了88分，「it paid off」代表值得，故選 C。(B) 不及格錯誤，(A) 他其實很緊張。
optionsZh: 他熬夜讀書並取得好成績。

dialogue:
Man: I'd like to send this package to the US.
Woman: Let me weigh it. It's two kilograms. Standard shipping or express?
Man: How long does standard take?
Woman: About ten to fourteen business days.
Man: I need it to arrive by next week. I'll go with express.
Woman: That'll be 650 dollars.
question: Why does the man choose express shipping?
options: (B) Because the package is too heavy for standard shipping.
(C) Because standard shipping takes too long.
explanation: 標準運送需 10–14 個工作天，但男士需要下週前到達，所以選快遞，故選 C。重量不是理由。
optionsZh: 因為快遞比標準運送便宜。
因為包裹太重無法用標準運送。
因為標準運送需要太長時間。

dialogue: Woman: Attention, shoppers. Our store will be closing in fifteen minutes. Please bring your selections to the register. Our summer sale ends today. All sale items are fifty percent off the original price. Thank you for your visit.
question: What is the main purpose of this announcement?
options: (B) To inform customers the store is closing and the sale ends today.
(C) To tell customers the store is moving to a new location.
explanation: 廣播通知 15 分鐘後關店，並提醒夏季特賣今天結束，(B) 符合廣播目的，故選 B。
optionsZh: 通知顧客即將關店並提醒夏季特賣今天結束。
告知顧客店鋪即將搬遷。

dialogue:
Man: Okay class, put your phones away. We're starting the lesson.
Woman: Can I use my phone to look up a word?
Man: Use the dictionary on your desk instead. Phones are not allowed during class.
Woman: But my dictionary is at home.
Man: You can borrow one from the bookshelf. Please put your phone in your bag.
question: What does the teacher ask the student to do?
options: (A) Put her phone away and borrow a dictionary from the bookshelf.
(B) Borrow a dictionary from a classmate.
(C) Use her phone to look up words.
explanation: 老師說手機不能用、字典可從書架借，並要求學生把手機放進書包，(A) 完全符合，故選 A。
optionsZh: 把手機收進書包並從書架借字典。

dialogue: Man: The girl is standing on a chair to reach the top shelf of the bookcase.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The girl is sitting on the floor reading a book.
(B) The girl is standing on a chair to reach the top shelf.
(C) The girl is sleeping in her bed.
explanation: 句子說「女孩站在椅子上要拿書櫃最上層的東西」，(B) 完全符合，故選 B。(A) 坐在地板看書、(C) 睡覺，均不符。
optionsZh: 女孩站在椅子上要拿書櫃最上層的東西。

dialogue: Woman: Two boys are playing basketball on the court behind the school.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) Two boys are playing basketball behind the school.
(B) One boy is reading alone in the classroom.
(C) Two boys are swimming in the pool.
explanation: 句子說「兩個男孩在學校後面的球場打籃球」，(A) 完全符合，故選 A。
optionsZh: 兩個男孩在學校後面打籃球。
一個男孩獨自在教室看書。
兩個男孩在游泳池游泳。

dialogue: Man: The old man is feeding the birds beside the lake every morning.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The old man is walking his dog in the park.
(B) The old man is feeding the birds beside the lake.
(C) The old man is fishing beside the lake.
explanation: 句子說「老先生每天早上在湖邊餵鳥」，(B) 完全符合，故選 B。
optionsZh: 老先生每天早上在湖邊餵鳥。

dialogue: Woman: The students are cleaning the classroom windows after class.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The students are drawing pictures on the board.
(B) The students are cleaning the classroom windows.
(C) The students are eating lunch in the classroom.
explanation: 句子說「學生放學後在擦教室的窗戶」，(B) 完全符合，故選 B。
optionsZh: 學生正在擦教室的窗戶。
學生正在教室裡吃午餐。

dialogue: Man: The baby is crying loudly because she dropped her toy on the floor.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The baby is crying because she dropped her toy.
(B) The baby is laughing at her toy.
(C) The baby is sleeping quietly in the room.
explanation: 句子說「嬰兒因為玩具掉在地上而大哭」，(A) 完全符合，故選 A。
optionsZh: 嬰兒因為玩具掉在地上而哭。
嬰兒在房間裡安靜地睡覺。

dialogue: Woman: The workers are building a new bridge across the river.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The workers are fixing a broken road.
(B) The workers are painting a house.
(C) The workers are building a new bridge across the river.
explanation: 句子說「工人正在河上建造一座新橋」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。
optionsZh: 工人正在修理損壞的道路。
工人正在河上建造一座新橋。

dialogue: Man: The cat is sleeping on top of the warm car in the sun.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The cat is running after a mouse.
(B) The cat is sleeping on top of a warm car.
(C) The cat is drinking milk from a bowl.
explanation: 句子說「貓咪在陽光下趴在溫暖的車頂睡覺」，(B) 完全符合，故選 B。
optionsZh: 貓咪趴在溫暖的車頂睡覺。

dialogue: Woman: The girl is drawing a picture of her family on a piece of paper.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The girl is writing a letter to her friend.
(B) The girl is folding paper into a boat.
(C) The girl is drawing a picture of her family.
explanation: 句子說「女孩正在紙上畫她的家人」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。
optionsZh: 女孩正在把紙折成小船。
女孩正在紙上畫她的家人。

dialogue: Man: The farmer is picking apples in the field early in the morning.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The farmer is planting seeds in the field.
(B) The farmer is picking apples in the field.
(C) The farmer is driving a truck to the market.
explanation: 句子說「農夫一大早在田裡摘蘋果」，(B) 完全符合，故選 B。

dialogue: Woman: The boy fell off his bike but he stood up and smiled.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The boy fell off his bike and started crying.
(B) The boy is riding his bike very fast.
(C) The boy fell off his bike but stood up and smiled.
explanation: 句子說「男孩從腳踏車上摔下來，但站起來笑了」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。
optionsZh: 男孩從腳踏車摔下來後哭了。
男孩正騎腳踏車騎得很快。
男孩摔下腳踏車但站起來笑了。

dialogue: Man: The teacher is writing new words on the board and the students are copying them.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The students are taking a test in silence.
(B) The teacher is writing new words and the students are copying them.
(C) The teacher is singing a song with the students.
explanation: 句子說「老師在黑板上寫新單字，學生們在抄寫」，(B) 完全符合，故選 B。
optionsZh: 老師寫新單字，學生們在抄寫。

dialogue: Woman: The waiter is bringing hot soup to the table by the window.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The waiter is cleaning the table by the window.
(B) The waiter is taking the menu away from the table.
(C) The waiter is bringing hot soup to the table by the window.
explanation: 句子說「服務生正端熱湯到窗邊的桌子」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。
optionsZh: 服務生正在清理窗邊的桌子。
服務生正把菜單從桌上收走。
服務生正端熱湯到窗邊的桌子。

dialogue: Man: The children are jumping into the pool one after another.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The children are drying their hair after a shower.
(B) The children are sitting quietly by the pool.
(C) The children are jumping into the pool one after another.
explanation: 句子說「孩子們一個接一個跳進游泳池」，(C) 完全符合，故選 C。
optionsZh: 孩子們洗完澡在吹乾頭髮。
孩子們安靜地坐在游泳池邊。
孩子們一個接一個跳進游泳池。

dialogue: Woman: The man is fixing the broken chair with a hammer in the yard.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The man is throwing away an old chair.
(B) The man is fixing the broken chair with a hammer.
(C) The man is buying a new chair at the store.
explanation: 句子說「男士在院子裡用鎚子修理壞掉的椅子」，(B) 完全符合，故選 B。
optionsZh: 男士正用鎚子修理壞掉的椅子。

dialogue: Man: The girl is helping her little brother tie his shoes before school.
question: Which description best matches what you heard?
options: (A) The girl is carrying her brother on her back.
(B) The girl is helping her little brother tie his shoes.
(C) The girl is teaching her brother to read.
explanation: 句子說「女孩在上學前幫弟弟綁鞋帶」，(B) 完全符合，故選 B。
optionsZh: 女孩正在幫弟弟綁鞋帶。

dialogue: Woman: What time does the movie start tonight?
question: Which is the best response?
options: (A) I like action movies the most.

options: (C) Because too many passengers are on board.

dialogue:

dialogue:
Woman: This shirt looks nice, but do you have it in a bigger size?

(C) Return the shirt for a refund.

Boy: Our science project is due Monday, and we haven't started the poster yet.

(C) Finish the poster at the boy's house.

Girl: My phone screen cracked when I dropped it this morning.

options: (C) Because the players were not ready.

explanation: 廣播主旨是收集舊衣物幫助有需要的家庭，故選 A。

Girl: Have you seen my umbrella? I can't find it anywhere.
Boy: I think you left it in the classroom yesterday.
Girl: Oh, you're right! I'll go check after class.

explanation: 男孩說女孩昨天可能把雨傘留在教室，故選 A。

Boy: I got a new puppy last weekend!

explanation: 男孩說是他妹妹幫小狗取名字，故選 C。

explanation: 氣象報告說星期六晴天，星期日大雨，建議野餐選星期六，故選 A。

dialogue:
Boy: Mom, can I have thirty more minutes on the computer? I'm almost done with this level.

explanation: 媽媽最後同意讓男孩多玩十五分鐘，故選 C。

explanation: 女孩說老師提到新同學是從別的城市搬來的，故選 C。

Man: Welcome to the museum. Tickets are one hundred dollars for adults and fifty for students with ID.

explanation: 女孩認為便當盒還在餐廳的桌上，故選 C。

Man: Okay, here is your boarding pass. The gate closes at ten thirty.

explanation: 女士說只有一個行李箱要托運，故選 C。

合唱團練習時間和鋼琴課衝突。

explanation: 電梯故障，所以要走樓梯，故選 C。

Woman: The art contest results are out. Did you check the board?

explanation: 男士說自己的畫作得了第二名，故選 C。

explanation: 廣播說因供應問題臨時改菜單，故選 C。

explanation: 廣播說撿到一副眼鏡，故選 B。

Student: How long should our presentation be?
Teacher: About five to seven minutes, including questions.
Student: Got it, we'll practice this weekend.
question: How long should the presentation be?
explanation: 老師說報告時間大約五到七分鐘，故選 B。

dialogue:
Girl: Why is your dog barking so loudly?
Boy: He always barks when someone walks past our house.
Girl: That's a good watchdog then.
Boy: Yeah, he never lets anyone get too close.
question: Why does the dog bark?
explanation: 男孩說狗每次有人經過就會叫，故選 A。

dialogue:
Mom: The doctor's appointment is at four thirty today.
Son: Do I need to leave school early?
Mom: Yes, I'll pick you up at four.
Son: Okay, I'll be ready at the school gate.
question: What time will the mom pick up her son?
explanation: 媽媽說會在四點去接兒子，故選 C。

dialogue:
Boy: This math homework is so hard. I can't figure it out.
Sister: Let me take a look. Oh, you just forgot to add the last step.
Boy: Really? Thanks for catching that.
Sister: No problem, that's what sisters are for.
question: What mistake did the boy make?
explanation: 姊姊指出男孩忘了最後一步，故選 B。

dialogue:
Girl: I can't decide what to wear for the school concert.
Mom: How about the blue dress? It looks great on you.
Girl: But it might be too formal.
Mom: Then wear it with sneakers to make it more casual.
question: What does the mom suggest to make the outfit casual?
explanation: 媽媽建議搭配球鞋讓穿搭比較輕便，故選 A。

dialogue:
Boy: I want to join the swim team this year.
Coach: Great! Practice is every Tuesday and Thursday after school.
Boy: What time does it end?
Coach: Around five thirty, so you'll have time for dinner.
question: How many days a week is swim practice?
explanation: 教練說每週二、四練習，共兩天，故選 B。

dialogue:
Girl: My little brother broke my favorite mug this morning.
Friend: Oh no, was he in trouble?
Girl: A little, but he said sorry and helped clean it up.
Friend: That's good. At least he took responsibility.
question: What did the girl's brother do after breaking the mug?
options: (C) He said sorry and cleaned up.
explanation: 弟弟道歉並幫忙清理，故選 C。

dialogue:
Boy: Are we still going camping next weekend?
Dad: Actually, the campsite is closed for repairs.
Boy: Oh no, what should we do instead?
Dad: Let's go to the lake for a day trip instead.
question: Why can't they go camping next weekend?
explanation: 爸爸說露營地正在維修關閉，故選 C。

dialogue:
Teacher: Please remember to bring your recorder tomorrow for music class.
Student: I think mine is broken. Can I borrow one?
Teacher: Sure, come see me before class starts.
Student: Thank you, I'll be there early.
question: What does the student need to borrow?
explanation: 學生要借直笛，因為自己的壞了，故選 A。

dialogue:
Girl: How was your trip to your cousin's house?
Boy: It was fun. We played board games all afternoon.
Girl: Did you win any?
Boy: I won two games, but my cousin won three.
question: How many games did the boy's cousin win?
explanation: 男孩說表哥贏了三場，故選 B。

dialogue:
Mom: Your uncle is coming to dinner tonight. Can you clean the living room?
Daughter: Sure, when will he arrive?
Mom: Around six thirty, right after work.
Daughter: Okay, I'll finish cleaning before then.
question: What time will the uncle arrive?
explanation: 媽媽說叔叔大約六點半到，故選 C。

dialogue:
Boy: Did you hear the school library got new books?
Girl: Yes! I already borrowed one about space travel.
Boy: Is it good so far?
Girl: Yes, it's really interesting. I'll lend it to you when I'm done.
question: What is the book the girl borrowed about?
explanation: 女孩借了一本關於太空旅行的書，故選 C。

dialogue:
Dad: We need to leave for the airport by six tomorrow morning.
Son: That early? What time should I wake up?
Dad: Wake up at five thirty so we have time to eat breakfast.
Son: Okay, I'll set my alarm now.
question: What time should the son wake up?
explanation: 爸爸說五點半起床才有時間吃早餐，故選 B。

dialogue:
Girl: I'm thinking of learning to play the guitar.
Brother: That's cool. Where will you take lessons?
Girl: There's a music school near our house.
Brother: I heard the teacher there is really good.
question: What does the girl want to learn?
explanation: 女孩說想學吉他，故選 C。

dialogue:
Boy: Our soccer game got moved to Sunday because of the storm.
Friend: What time on Sunday?
Boy: Same time as before, ten in the morning.
Friend: Okay, I'll be there.
question: Why was the soccer game moved?
explanation: 男孩說因為暴風雨比賽改到星期天，故選 C。

dialogue:
Girl: Have you started your winter break homework yet?
Boy: A little. I finished the reading log but not the art project.
Girl: What are you drawing for the art project?
Boy: I'm drawing my family's trip to the mountains last year.
question: What has the boy finished so far?
explanation: 男孩說完成了閱讀紀錄，但美術作業還沒做，故選 A。
